svg.text: Base map, first sketches: four ways to lay out the model

g.text: Each place has its own small loops off the walk. Mechanisms can repeat.
Every stop leads into the same model; each mechanism appears once.
The walk is a loop. Justifications lead back to it; change leaves it.
One visual grammar, shared by all four sketches
A path off the walk that comes back to it (prevention, justification)
A path that leaves and doesn't come back (change)
A mechanism, sitting on its path
A place on the walk, with what it can set off
The end: the same as before
Pictograms: one ink, one weight, used sparingly
Black and white on purpose. Your own route will be added on top in one colour.
After your fourth reference: woods, a river and hills stand for the parts of the model. Paths branch and join.
